items.text: All three round-001 decisions were resolved and folded into plan.md. d1 = A (always show options, no flag). d2 = A (indented-list layout: key + label, (recommended) marker after label, rationale indented below). d3 = B (CLI + UI parity scope; API already correct via --json).

Plan now uses a two-phase implementation strategy. Phase 1 ships the CLI fix and performs a quick UI spot-check on the decision-detail view. Phase 2 (UI fix) runs only if the spot-check finds the same gap; otherwise it is skipped and the result recorded in the rollout checklist. This bounds the d3 = B scope expansion: effort stays at XS if the UI is already correct, grows toward S only if a real UI gap is found.

Contract Decisions section now states the resolved choices instead of pointing to round-001. Target End State, Implementation Strategy, Testing Plan, Rollout Checklist, Risks, and Definition of Done all reflect d1 = A and d2 = A; Scope and Definition of Done explicitly cover the d3 = B UI parity verification step.

Initiative neighborhood: prompt-manager-decision-workflow-polish has no upstream or downstream initiatives, so there are no cross-initiative sequencing implications. Sibling items are unchanged from round-001's analysis: decision-accept-no-options-ergonomics shares operator-experience but no code; heartbeat-list and initiative-proposal-auto-create are unrelated. Workshop info i1 from round-001 (verifying that recently-shipped deferred-status and structured-modifications fields render in decision-show) is preserved as a 'flag-and-file-separately' instruction in Risks and Initiative Neighborhood Notes — not absorbed into this fix's scope.

Readiness re-scored to 3/3/3/3/3. Problem and scope are fully specified; approach is concrete and phased; tests are enumerated per surface; risks include the relevant XS-effort blowout case (UI gap larger than expected) with a bounded mitigation. Item is ready to queue.

plan_updates: Replaced 'see workshop round-001 for option sets' Contract Decisions placeholder with the resolved d1/d2/d3 selections. Reworked Implementation Strategy from single-phase to two-phase (CLI always; UI conditional on parity check). Updated Scope, Target End State, Testing Plan, Rollout Checklist, Risks, Non-goals, and Definition of Done to reflect always-on display (no new flag), indented-list layout, and CLI + UI parity scope. Added explicit cross-initiative implications statement (none) to Initiative Neighborhood Notes. Removed sibling-fix's API/UI scope-creep risk (resolved by d3) and replaced with a UI-effort-blowout risk bounded by the conditional Phase 2.
